scope: Public GF180 planning constraints and pinned model arithmetic; no new layout, matching rule-deck execution, EM qualification or foundry signoff.

sources.locator: 10.3 HRES Poly Resistor, HRES.2 and HRES.11
sources.interpretation: A 1 um wide 1 kohm input resistor can approach several mA during a fast 3.3 V edge; this exceeds a conservative instantaneous application of HRES.11. The public table does not provide a pulsed-duration derating in this section. Average-current arguments alone do not establish compliance. A 4 um wide, 4 um long resistor keeps approximately one square and reduces that conservative density estimate, while increasing model substrate capacitance.
sources.limits: Current density must ultimately use extracted device current, temperature and the selected PDK reliability flow. Geometric mitigation is not an EM pass.

sources.locator: 10.4.2 MIM Option B, MIMTM.8a and process-option note
sources.interpretation: Option B uses the top-metal/top-metal-minus-one stack. It is an option for four-or-more-metal processes. Option A and B cannot be combined in the same process. GF180D having five metal layers does not by itself identify a chosen MIM option or density; the selected full PDK and fabrication option must establish that.
sources.limits: A 5–20 fF ideal capacitor cannot be claimed to be a minimum-area single MIM implementation from this rule alone. Series capacitors, a qualified MOM implementation or another approved option need actual device/parasitic validation.

sources.locator: .LIB cap_mim, .subckt cap_mim_1f0fF and cap_mim_1f5fF; model lines39173–39227 in this frozen copy
sources.calculation: C=area_density*(5*5)+edge_density*(2*(5+5)), at nominal cap corner and before temperature correction. The model includes separate MIM corner/mismatch terms.
sources.limits: The B candidate CFF remains a lumped capacitor. These arithmetic values motivate a realizable scale but do not instantiate or validate the PDK MIM device, substrate/coupling parasitics, voltage/temperature tolerance, or series-capacitor midpoint behavior.

candidate_implications.B_rin1: Input-RC ablation only. Net0.8Gb/s zero errors but receiver margin worsens and CMOS GB PFET drain/body forward peak becomes0.31356V, above0.3V project research screen.
candidate_implications.B_fast_wide: Tested 4um width and4um length input-resistor geometry with faster predrivers: both DC levels pass1%; net0.8Gb/s still has12 validation errors. Its resistor-current density/EM and layout are not signed off.
candidate_implications.B_wide_ff31p275: Lumped31.275fF candidate passes tested net0.8,1.2,1.6,2.0Gb/s and fails complete receiver at2.4 and3.2Gb/s. It passes the electrical-only receiver even at3.2Gb/s. 31.275fF matches nominal arithmetic of a5x5um1fF/um2MIM model with fringe, but no PDK MIM device or layout is instantiated.
